replies.tweet_text: Complexity is not an intrinsic property of a problem. It's a property of the relationship between a problem and an observer. Once you know the shape of the problem it is no longer complex.
replies.reply_text: Credit scoring proves this. FICO looked like black magic until lenders mapped the seven variables. Complexity dissolved, margin compressed, the edge moved upstream.
